subject: Sporting agree about 5 million euro buyout with Lyon for Paulo Fonseca after sacking Borges
title: Sporting's coach search, Fonseca price tag

lines.vo: Paulo Fonseca has a price tag. It is five million euros.
Sporting and Lyon agreed that much in compensation. Fonseca is fifty-three and reportedly open to the move.
Sporting are third, nine points behind Porto. They also lost at home to LASK in Europe.
Rui Borges took over in December two thousand twenty-four, after Amorim left. Talks to end his contract have begun.
Tiago Fernandes takes temporary charge before the Shakhtar match. Congratulations, and good luck.
Sporting are third. Lyon are third too. Fonseca could swap third place in France for third place in Portugal. Same view, five million euros.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news, betting tips and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.

facts_used: Sporting began talks to end Rui Borges's contract; Tiago Fernandes put in temporary charge before the Shakhtar UCL match (news 92; espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50359218)
About 5 million euro compensation agreed with Lyon for Paulo Fonseca, 53; personal terms next; reportedly open to the move (news 92)
Lyon sat third in Ligue 1 when reported (news 92)
Sporting third, nine points behind Porto; lost at home to LASK in the Champions League (news 92)
Borges took over December 2024 after Amorim left; Sporting lost to Arsenal in last season's UCL quarter-finals (news 92 background)
notes: Punched up: price-tag hook, 'congratulations and good luck' for the interim boss, 'same view, five million euros' twist. Headline says Borges was sacked; body says talks to end his contract, so script says 'talks have begun'. Move is not final (personal terms next), so 'could swap'. Non-comic, no inserts.
